items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The crime kingpin isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 12th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking, or using Surprise Attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Kingpin's Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet.

Allies in the aura gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: You'll Pay for That
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages the kingpin

Effect The kingpin issues a vendetta against the enemy. Each of the kingpin's allies who hears the command gains a +5 status bonus to their next damage roll against that enemy.

Effect: You'll Pay for That

offensiveAbilities.name: Fencing Brawl
offensiveAbilities.description: The kingpin attempts a rapier Strike followed by a Disarm or Grapple attempt against the same enemy. These count as one attack for the kingpin's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Kick Away
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The kingpin knocks an item out of a creature's grasp using Disarm

Effect The kingpin kicks the weapon up to 20 feet in any direction. If the kingpin kicks the weapon into an ally's square, that ally can catch the weapon as a free action, Releasing anything else they're holding if necessary.

offensiveAbilities.name: Kingpin's Command
offensiveAbilities.description: The crime kingpin shouts a command to an ally of their choice. That ally can spend a reaction to Stride and Strike. The ally becomes immune to Kingpin's Command for 24 hours.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The crime kingpin deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
